# The corpus `$GEN.USER_AGENT` picks from (#1112): one real browser User-Agent per line, as the
# browser itself sends it by default — never a synthesised string, since a made-up UA is worse
# than none. Embedded at compile time; nothing is fetched at send time. Blank lines and `#` lines
# are ignored; an empty corpus fails the build.
#
# DESKTOP ONLY, on purpose: one run picks per send, and a mobile UA pulls a different site
# (links, lengths, baselines) than a desktop one. The pick is uniform, so the MIX is the weight —
# Chromium dominant, then Firefox and Safari, roughly as real desktop traffic splits.
#
# Refreshing: bump the majors to current stable. Chromium's reduced UA freezes everything after
# the major (`153.0.0.0`) and Safari freezes the OS token at `10_15_7` — change only `Version/`.
# Last refreshed: 2026-09 (Chrome 153, Edge 153, Firefox 156, Safari 27.0).
